# Agile Legal Solutions

> Law practice in Rohini, New Delhi, led by Advocate Arun Kumar Jha. Practice areas: trademark search, trademark registration (Form TM-A), objection replies, hearings, opposition proceedings, renewal, copyright, patent and industrial design filings, and intellectual property dispute representation. Information provided on this website is for general informational purposes in compliance with Bar Council of India regulations and is not legal advice or a solicitation.

## Practice Pages
- [Intellectual Property Lawyer and Trademark Advocate in Delhi](https://www.agiletrademarkfiling.com/): Law practice overview and chamber consultation.
- [Trademark Lawyer in Delhi](https://www.agiletrademarkfiling.com/trademark-lawyer-delhi): Trademark services before the Trade Marks Registry, Dwarka, Delhi.
- [IPR Law Firm in Delhi](https://www.agiletrademarkfiling.com/ipr-law-firm-delhi): Comprehensive trademark, copyright, patent, and industrial design advisory.
- [Trademark Registration in Delhi](https://www.agiletrademarkfiling.com/trademark-registration-delhi): End-to-end statutory trademark registration process in India.
- [Trademark Search in India](https://www.agiletrademarkfiling.com/trademark-search-india): IP India public search methodology and NICE classification guidance.
- [Trademark Objection Reply](https://www.agiletrademarkfiling.com/trademark-objection-reply): Legal drafting and statutory defense for Section 9 and Section 11 examination reports.
- [About Advocate Arun Kumar Jha](https://www.agiletrademarkfiling.com/about-advocate): Professional background, bar enrollment, and IP practice profile.
